starting_zoning_or_status: Existing LI/GI/HI or conditional industrial zoning inside an established node
starting_flum_character_area: Industrial or Urban / industrial-supportive character area
target_zoning_or_use: Industrial use confirmation condition modification CUP variance or site-plan execution
customer_read: Best customer starting point because the public question is usually operations conditions traffic buffers or utilities rather than whether industrial belongs there
case_examples: Project Orchid existing LI-Conditional; Rush Truck Centers existing conditional LI
conditions_or_friction: Legacy conditions water demand impervious area buffer changes parking variance stormwater and traffic circulation still matter
acquisition_rule: Prioritize parcels already zoned industrial and underwrite condition resets as deal costs

starting_zoning_or_status: A-2 Agricultural Rural Farm next to an established I-85 US 129 airport or Bill Wright industrial node
starting_flum_character_area: Urban and/or Industrial FLUM either existing or supportable through map amendment
target_zoning_or_use: LI or GI warehouse office-distribution maintenance or industrial park
customer_read: Convertible when it completes an existing industrial pattern and has arterial access utilities buffers and manageable neighbors
case_examples: Tom White EastGroup A-2 to LI; Valentine A-2 to GI; Choice A-2 to GI pending local action; Ingram A-2 to GI
conditions_or_friction: Usually requires road upgrades stream/zoning buffers traffic controls and clear utility path; stronger when industrial use already exists or the site sits in the node
acquisition_rule: Do not buy rural A-2 just because it is cheap; buy A-2 only where the industrial node story is obvious

starting_zoning_or_status: Commercial or highway commercial frontage in an industrializing corridor
starting_flum_character_area: Commercial Highway Business or urbanizing corridor with industrial neighbors
target_zoning_or_use: LI M-1 or industrial-support commercial support use
customer_read: Good conversion lane where frontage already carries nonresidential intensity and surrounding pattern is industrializing
case_examples: Concord Road C-2 to LI; Taylor & Mathis county A-2 plus city C-2 context to Commerce M-1
conditions_or_friction: Traffic access stream buffers parcel assembly annexation and use-specific conditions determine value
acquisition_rule: Commercial frontage can be a strong industrial basis if it is at the right node and not serving a residential plan area

starting_zoning_or_status: Unincorporated county land at a city edge with utility or access logic
starting_flum_character_area: Urban industrial or commercial context depending on city plan
target_zoning_or_use: Annexation plus municipal industrial zoning such as Commerce M-1 or Pendergrass/Jefferson industrial district
customer_read: Useful strategic path because city utilities and city zoning may produce cleaner development mechanics than county-only entitlement
case_examples: Taylor & Mathis Commerce annexation rezoning and conditional use
conditions_or_friction: Annexation acreage conditions parent-parcel assembly creek exclusions buffers plat conditions and city council approval
acquisition_rule: Model city versus county path before LOI because tax utility impact fee and condition economics can change

starting_zoning_or_status: GI or mixed GI/A-2 land seeking HI or special-use heavy industry
starting_flum_character_area: Urban/Industrial may help but residential edges still matter
target_zoning_or_use: HI special use quarry mining heavy industrial or similar nuisance-potential use
customer_read: Possible but not ordinary warehouse entitlement; customer should expect opposition and heavy conditions
case_examples: Jackson Quarry / Vulcan expansion GI and A-2 to HI plus SUP
conditions_or_friction: Split votes road restrictions blasting noise dust screening dark-sky lighting buffers right-of-way donations and truck-routing limits
acquisition_rule: Treat heavy industrial upside as a separate entitlement thesis with legal technical and community budget

starting_zoning_or_status: A-2 agricultural land near growth but without a closed local approval
starting_flum_character_area: Industrial or Urban requested but not final
target_zoning_or_use: GI LI M-1 or industrial park
customer_read: Potentially convertible but not bankable until local action closes; DRI or market status alone is not enough
case_examples: Choice Equipment; Jackson Farms; Project Fortune; Pendergrass Assemblage where industrial relevance is unresolved
conditions_or_friction: Local vote annexation utility conditions and parcel baseline control the actual value
acquisition_rule: Use as lead generation and price with entitlement contingency until local ordinance/site-plan proof is in hand

starting_zoning_or_status: Agricultural Forestry Conservation Rural Country Living or Suburban plan context where industrial creates a new edge
starting_flum_character_area: Agricultural Conservation Suburban Residential or rural-protection designations
target_zoning_or_use: Urban Industrial HI GI LI or truck-intensive use
customer_read: Hardest conversion path because the case must change the land-use story before it can win zoning
case_examples: Whoville Partners withdrawn; East Jackson Quarry adverse compatibility signal; Hwy 124 / Maddox adverse truck/drop-lot signal
conditions_or_friction: Public opposition road/bridge limits environmental constraints residential displacement dust noise water and truck routing dominate
acquisition_rule: Do not underwrite as industrial land without a deep entitlement discount and a credible plan-map strategy

starting_zoning_or_status: Truck stop diesel fueling drop lot or truck terminal outside a proven truck/industrial node
starting_flum_character_area: Residential or rural plan context or weak local-road network
target_zoning_or_use: HRC truck special use truck drop lot diesel/truck-support use
customer_read: Truck-support demand is real but the use is not portable across the county; location and circulation decide feasibility
case_examples: Hwy 124 / Maddox drop lot adverse signal; 7-Eleven/Peterbilt local action pending; RaceTrac diesel expansion in Jefferson node
conditions_or_friction: Fuel/spill controls driveway geometry truck queues local roads neighboring homes and special-use conditions dominate
acquisition_rule: Only pursue truck-support sites where interchange access and surrounding industrial/commercial pattern are already obvious
